name: Mythos Gates: Ascension Combat System
designPillar: One-Deity Power Fantasy: The player controls one active champion who carves through many enemies with readable, spectacular combat.
corePrinciples: Player controls ONE deity at a time in real-time combat
Face waves of enemies, elite foes, and boss encounters
Combat is weighty, divine, and spectacular but visually readable
Mobile-first controls: virtual joystick + ability buttons + dodge
Tactical clarity: strong silhouettes, readable telegraphs, clear AoE markers
Each deity has a distinct combat identity, element, and playstyle

controls.basicAttack: Tap button — auto-targets nearest enemy, combo chain
controls.ability1: Tap button — short cooldown (5-8s), tactical use
controls.ability2: Tap button — medium cooldown (8-12s), stronger effect
controls.signature: Tap button — long cooldown (15-20s), big impact
controls.ultimate: Tap button — once per battle or long cooldown (60s+), cinematic
controls.dodge: Swipe/dash — i-frames, brief invincibility, directional dodge

resources.divineEnergy: Built from basic attacks and taking damage. Spent on abilities 1, 2, and Signature.
resources.ascensionGauge: Built throughout the battle from all combat actions. At 100%, Ultimate/Ascension is unlocked.
resources.factionResource: Each faction has a unique resource (Solar Charge, Oath Fury, Divine Glory, etc.) that powers the deity's passive ability.

abilityKit.basicAttack: No cooldown. Spammable. Builds Divine Energy. Unique per deity. 3-4 hit combo chain with unique properties.
abilityKit.ability1: Short cooldown (5-8s). Low Divine Energy cost (20-30). Tactical ability — mobility, CC, shield, or buff.
abilityKit.ability2: Medium cooldown (8-12s). Medium Divine Energy cost (35-45). Stronger ability — AoE, heavy damage, or sustain.
abilityKit.signature: Long cooldown (15-20s). High Divine Energy cost (65-75). Signature divine skill — the deity's mythic power unleashed.
abilityKit.ultimate: Once per battle or 60s+ cooldown. Requires 100 Ascension Gauge. Transforms the deity or unleashes full divine power. Cinematic.
abilityKit.passive: Always active. Builds faction resource from combat actions. At threshold, empowers next ability or attack.

enemyDesign.waves: Trash mobs — easily killed by basic attacks, come in groups of 5-15
enemyDesign.elites: Tougher enemies with special abilities — require ability usage, come in pairs or small groups
enemyDesign.bosses: Divine trials, gate guardians, corrupted gods — require full ability rotation and dodge timing
enemyDesign.hollow: Hollow-corrupted variants of realm enemies — twisted, dangerous, destabilized

combatFantasy: One legendary god-like deity enters enemy-controlled territory alone, fights through many coordinated enemies, grows visibly stronger, and eventually destroys forces that once seemed impossible.
mobileReadability: Strong silhouettes, clear telegraph lines for enemy attacks, obvious AoE markers on the ground, large touch targets for ability buttons, readable health bars and cooldown indicators.

avatar_system.deity_status: Safe in home Realm — never dies

old_roles.Endurance: Win while staying above 50% HP the entire fight. Rewards sustained composure.
old_roles.Conduit: Win after executing 3+ ability combo chains in one encounter. Rewards ability mastery.
old_roles.Dominion: Win while controlling 60%+ of battlefield nodes. Rewards spatial control.
old_roles.Fracture: Win after breaking 3+ enemy armor/defense stacks. Rewards aggressive offense.
old_roles.Disruption: Win after interrupting 3+ enemy attacks. Rewards tactical awareness.
old_roles.Range: Win with 5+ ranged kills. Rewards precision from distance.
old_roles.Counter: Win after blocking/parrying 5+ enemy attacks. Rewards defensive mastery.
old_roles.Shadow: Win with 3+ stealth or timed-critical executions. Rewards precise timing.
old_roles.Bulwark: Win without taking a hit from the boss. Rewards perfect dodging.

Endurance.name: Endurance — The Unbroken
Endurance.trigger: Win while staying above 50% HP the entire fight
Endurance.description: The Avatar's faith is rewarded when their body endures. Above the threshold, they are unbreakable.

Conduit.name: Conduit — The Weaver
Conduit.trigger: Win after executing 3+ ability combo chains in one encounter
Conduit.description: The Avatar channels divine energy like a living conduit. Each chain is proof the divine flow is endless.

Dominion.name: Dominion — The Sovereign
Dominion.trigger: Win while controlling 60%+ of battlefield nodes
Dominion.description: The Avatar bends the battlefield to their will. Every node claimed is territory marked by the divine.

Fracture.name: Fracture — The Breaker
Fracture.trigger: Win after breaking 3+ enemy armor/defense stacks
Fracture.description: The Avatar shatters what cannot be shattered. Every shield destroyed is proof of divine power.

Disruption.name: Disruption — The Storm
Disruption.description: The Avatar breaks the enemy's rhythm. Every interrupted attack proves the enemy's will is meaningless.

Range.name: Range — The Hunter
Range.description: The Avatar strikes from beyond reach. Every ranged kill proves distance is no defense.

Counter.name: Counter — The Shield
Counter.trigger: Win after blocking or parrying 5+ enemy attacks
Counter.description: The Avatar stands unmovable. Every parry proves divine skill outmatches brute force.

Shadow.name: Shadow — The Unseen
Shadow.trigger: Win with 3+ stealth or timed-critical executions
Shadow.description: The Avatar strikes from the unseen. Every critical strike proves death comes before the enemy knows it.

Bulwark.name: Bulwark — The Untouchable
Bulwark.trigger: Win without taking a hit from the boss
Bulwark.description: The Avatar is beyond harm. A flawless victory proves the divine form is inviolable.

balance_note: All 28 deities use the same 9 triggers. Optimal play = 130 Belief/win, standard = 115/win. ~13% gap.
